title: SSH Provisioning Variables
description: Run-time SSH provisioning credentials for the ssh_provisioning role. Names are flat, camelCase, and prefixed with sshProvisioning.

sshProvisioningOperations.description: Ordered SSH provisioning operation workflows to run. The role executes each matching tasks/<operation>.yml file in list order.

sshProvisioningUsername.description: SSH username used to connect to a host that is being provisioned. Supplied at run time on the command line (-e sshProvisioningUsername=...); never persisted.

sshProvisioningPassword.description: SSH password used to connect to a host that is being provisioned. Supplied at run time on the command line (-e sshProvisioningPassword=...); never persisted.

sshFileName.description: Basename of the local SSH keypair generated or validated by the ssh_provisioning role.

sshKeyOverwrite.description: Replace an existing local SSH keypair with the configured sshFileName when true.
